jobs.description_snippet: Meta is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to drive the technical direction of low-level software systems powering Meta's next generation of wearable and consumer hardware devices. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers focused on device factory software development, ensuring seamless integration between manufacturing processes and embedded systems. You will work closely with internal engineering leads as well as external partners including vendors and factory stakeholders to align on requirements, timelines, and quality standards. You will architect and deliver embedded software solutions spanning firmware, real-time operating systems, hardware abstraction layers, and system services, collaborating closely with hardware, silicon, and product teams to bring innovative wearable experiences to life at scale.
